environment.description: ECS Fargate service in private subnet (no IGW route) behind internal ALB. The admin Lambda function URL has AuthType=AWS_IAM configured. The ECS task execution role has a permissions boundary (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/FargateTaskBoundary) that explicitly denies lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl. The task role itself retains lambda:InvokeFunction but the Lambda resource policy restricts invocation to principals with condition aws:PrincipalTag/team=platform-eng (the Fargate task role is tagged team=app-runtime). Additionally, the Lambda function URL's resource-based policy has a Deny statement for any principal not matching the specific IAM role arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:role/PlatformAdminInvoker. The container runs with readOnlyRootFilesystem=true and user=1000 (non-root). An AWS App Mesh virtual node sidecar is deployed with mTLS enforcement, but the X-Internal-Service-Auth validation in the application code is independent of the mesh authentication layer.

config.lambda_condition: aws:PrincipalTag/team != platform-eng results in implicit deny
